title: gentiana angulosa var. pontica
intro: Gentiana angulosa var. pontica, commonly known as Pontic gentian, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The plant is known to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions like expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Pontic gentian include gentiopicrin, gentiogenin, and gentianine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
